purpose: Define a reproducible, leakage-safe candidate grid after reviewing the 2026-10-13 UEFA Champions League Matchday 2 manual market-adjusted predictions.

production_parameters.note: No production parameter is changed by this candidate file. Existing V5.1 and historical predictions remain untouched.

asian_handicap.role: candidate prior for expected goal difference
asian_handicap.sign_convention: Normalize all providers to a documented home-team handicap convention before use.
forbidden: using handicap directly as H/D/A label
substituting Asian handicap for official Sporttery handicap

total_goals.role: candidate prior for expected total goals
forbidden: treating high total line as a guarantee of over

timestamp_policy.missing_or_unverifiable_snapshot_behavio: market feature unavailable; corresponding blend weight forced to 0

candidate_model_form.note: The market-line-to-prior mappings must be calibrated on an earlier training/calibration window. Do not equate raw handicap or total line directly with goal expectations.

evaluation_plan.acceptance: Do not promote unless independent time-holdout results are reproducible and neither Brier nor LogLoss worsens.
evaluation_plan.parameter_selection: Choose parameters only on the earlier calibration window; do not tune on the final holdout or on the nine reviewed matches.

error_pattern: undercalled away-team goal tail in Inter vs Club Brugge and Galatasaray vs Barcelona
undercalled home-team goals and draw risk in Viking vs Bayern
overcalled total goals in Leipzig vs PSV
missed upset direction in Sabah vs Slavia and Lens vs Sporting
review_observations.interpretation_limit: These were manually adjusted market-reference predictions, not a replay of V5.2 production outputs; n=9 is diagnostic only and insufficient for parameter estimation.
